“原来是施施，我听老蔡提过你，你比照片上好看多了。”

站在糖嫣旁边的纪如璟热情接过话题。

她作为一个经纪人，早已习惯八面玲珑，见面先捧一句。

“这位是....”

“我是她的经纪人纪如璟。”

两人轻轻握手。

“你好你好。”

双方都很客气。

随后刘施施邀请：“等会一起吃饭吧，他们马上下来。”

说话间，魏沐胡哥袁红三兄弟，有说有笑的从电梯门口出来。

“我跟你说这次中国男篮必进8强。”

“那不是废话，有姚明在，我觉得有希望杀进四强！！”

“不好说，咱们被分到死亡之组，首场打美国队，少输当赢。”

三人聊得正开心，迎面便撞上了在前台聊天的刘施施和糖嫣。

瞎姐朝他们招了招手：“来见一下新同事，这位是糖嫣。”

刘施施如此热情，让糖嫣心里暖暖的。

她人还怪好的。

纪如璟微微眯起眼睛，她的注意力全在魏沐身上。

小伙子长得确实帅，还是创作型歌手，前途不可限量啊。

“施施。”

听到动静，胡哥朝这边看过来，嘴角的笑容刚要扬起便僵住。

袁红和他反应一样，他看过《体面》MV，如今第一次见真人。

糖嫣给他们的第一印象就是高，在三个女人当中鹤立鸡群。

“你们好，我叫糖嫣。”

挥了挥手，她朝着魏沐笑了笑，后者轻轻点头。

刘施施一双眼睛没好气地在他们两人身上来回打量，没有再说话。

“纪姐，你先带糖糖去收拾行李，我们在饭店等你们。”

“好。”

短暂分开，纪如璟带着助理和糖嫣一起来到酒店房间。

收拾好东西，她来到浴室门口，轻声提醒：“魏沐有没有女朋友？你能搞清楚这点吗？”

“我不清楚，或许有吧....”，正在换衣服的糖嫣闻言顿了顿，有些泄气。

她一直不敢问，生怕问出来对方有女朋友。

“我觉得他有女朋友的可能性很大，像这种人气歌手即便没有女朋友，也会有伴侣，你懂我的意思吧？”

“我知道....”

两人都在香江待过一段时间，不是没见过世面的傻白甜。

“我觉得那个刘施施就是......”

"It turns out to be Shi Shi. I heard Lao Cai mention you. You look much better than in the photo."

Ji Rujing, standing next to Tang Yan, enthusiastically took over the topic.

As an agent, she has long been accustomed to being well-rounded and always complimenting someone when they meet.

"This is..."

"I am her agent Ji Rujing."

The two shook hands gently.

"Hello hello."

Both sides were very polite.

Then Liu Shishi invited: "Let's have dinner together later, they will come down soon."

While they were talking, the three brothers, Wei Mu, Hu, and Yuan Hong, came out of the elevator door talking and laughing.

"I tell you that the Chinese men's basketball team will enter the top 8 this time."

"That's not nonsense. With Yao Ming here, I think there is hope of reaching the semi-finals!!"

"It's hard to say. We were assigned to the group of death. We will play the American team in the first game. If we lose less, we will win."

The three of them were chatting happily when they bumped into Liu Shishi and Tang Yan chatting at the front desk.

The blind sister waved to them: "Come to meet the new colleague, this is Tang Yan."

Liu Shishi was so enthusiastic, which made Tang Yan feel warm in her heart.

She's quite nice.

Ji Rujing narrowed her eyes slightly, focusing entirely on Wei Mu.

The young man is indeed handsome, and he is also a singer-songwriter. His future is limitless.

"Shi Shi."

Hearing the noise, Brother Hu looked over here, and the smile on his lips froze just as he was about to raise it.

Yuan Hong had the same reaction as him. He had seen the "Decent" MV and now it was his first time seeing a real person.

The first impression Tang Yan gave them was that she was tall and stood out among the three women.

"Hello, my name is Tang Yan."

After waving her hand, she smiled at Wei Mu, who nodded slightly.

Liu Shishi looked back and forth between the two of them angrily and said nothing.

"Sister Ji, take Tangtang to pack your luggage first. We will wait for you at the hotel."

"Okay."

After a brief separation, Ji Rujing brought her assistant and Tang Yan to the hotel room.

After packing her things, she came to the bathroom door and reminded softly: "Does Wei Mu have a girlfriend? Can you figure this out?"

"I don't know, maybe..." Tang Yan, who was changing clothes, paused and felt a little discouraged.

She had never dared to ask, for fear of finding out that the other person had a girlfriend.

"I think it's very likely that he has a girlfriend. Even if a popular singer like this doesn't have a girlfriend, he will still have a partner. Do you understand what I mean?"

"I know..."

Both of them have spent some time in Xiangjiang, and they are not stupid people who have never seen the world.

"I think Liu Shishi is..."
